units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 37a:5">Snh. 37ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Song of Songs 7:3">Cant. VII, 3</cite>) <he>אפי׳ בס׳ של שושנים וכ׳</he> even in a fence of lilies they will make no breach (they will not trespass a law however slightly guarded).
<cite ref="Song of Songs 7:3">Ib.</cite> (second time) <he>בס׳ בשושנים</he> ed. (Ms. M. <he>של ש׳</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).
